summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of EDARSA HUB - Módulo de Catálogos. All test cases for Finanzas_ConfiguracionTPV_Sucursal CRUD passed successfully. Verified navigation, domain selection, catalog viewing, record editing, persistence to SQL Server, and value restoration.

issues: Console warning: 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' - minor hydration issue in server select dropdown (pre-existing from previous iterations)
Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' - accessibility improvement needed

critical_code_review_comments: Catálogos module correctly implements domain-based organization with 10 domains (Generales, RH, Nómina, Compras, Inventarios, Activos Fijos, Finanzas, Ventas, Seguridad, Homologación)
data-testid attributes properly implemented: dominio-{id} for domains, catalogo-{tabla} for catalog buttons
Edit modal dynamically renders form fields based on ESTRUCTURA_TABLAS schema
SQL Server persistence working correctly via /api/catalogos/tabla/{tabla}/{id} PUT endpoint
Toast notifications (sonner) properly showing success/error messages
Table displays first 6 columns with edit/deactivate action buttons
seed_data_creation: No seed data created - used existing Finanzas_ConfiguracionTPV_Sucursal records
context_for_next_testing_agent: Catálogos module fully tested. Key findings: 1) Navigation to /catalogos works correctly. 2) Domain selection via data-testid='dominio-{id}' requires mouse.click() at element center for proper React state update. 3) Catalog selection via data-testid='catalogo-{tabla}' works correctly. 4) Edit modal opens with all editable fields from ESTRUCTURA_TABLAS. 5) PUT /api/catalogos/tabla/{tabla}/{id} correctly updates SQL Server records. 6) Finanzas_ConfiguracionTPV_Sucursal has 8 records with fields: ConfiguracionTPVID, SucursalID, ProveedorTPV, ComisionDebito, ComisionCredito, ComisionAmex, ComisionInternacional, etc.
